info.title: VW user API
info.description: Manage your own vw build environments. Callers are identified by a Github access token.

get.summary: Get an environment with the specified name.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of this environment to create.

put.summary: Create an environment with the specified name.
put.description:
The images the environment's instances boot from are chosen here and pinned for the life of the environment. Any image named in the body must already exist.

Returns the ssh keypair generated for the new environment, so a caller can save it without a second round trip. The same pair is available afterwards from `get_environment_keys`.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of this environment to create.

delete.summary: Delete an environment with the specified name.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of this environment to create.

get.summary: Fetch the ssh keypair that opens an environment's instances.
get.description: The private key is only ever handed to the environment's owner.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of this environment to create.

get.summary: Return a list of all environments for the calling user.

Environment.description: An environment is a collection of instances that work together to build, analyze and test vw designs.

artifact_instance.description: The Oxide instance id for the artifact instance.

helios_instance.description: The Oxide instance id for the helios instance.

images.description:
The images this environment's instances boot from, chosen when the environment was created.

Absent when the service has no Oxide backend configured, in which case the environment is a bare record that will never be provisioned.

vivado_instance.description: The Oxide instance id for the vivado instance.

EnvironmentCreate.description:
Body of a request to create an environment.

Every field is optional; an image left unset is resolved to the newest image the service can see whose name matches that instance kind's convention. An image named here must already exist, or the request is rejected.

artifact_image.description: Name of the image the artifact instance should boot from.

helios_image.description: Name of the image the helios instance should boot from.

vivado_image.description: Name of the image the vivado instance should boot from.

EnvironmentImages.description: The images each of an environment's instances boots from.

artifact.description: Image the artifact instance boots from.

helios.description: Image the helios instance boots from.

vivado.description: Image the vivado instance boots from.

items.description: list of items on this page of results

next_page.description: token used to fetch the next page of results (if any)

ImageRef.description:
An Oxide image an environment's instances are built from.

Pinned by id, so publishing a newer image does not silently change what an existing environment boots. The name is carried along for display.

InstanceState.description:
Running state of an Instance (primarily: booted or stopped)

This typically reflects whether it's starting, running, stopping, or stopped, but also includes states related to the Instance's lifecycle

<details><summary>JSON schema</summary>

```json { "description": "Running state of an Instance (primarily: booted or stopped)\n\nThis typically reflects whether it's starting, running, stopping, or stopped, but also includes states related to the Instance's lifecycle", "oneOf": [ { "description": "The instance is being created.", "type": "string", "enum": [ "creating" ] }, { "description": "The instance is currently starting up.", "type": "string", "enum": [ "starting" ] }, { "description": "The instance is currently running.", "type": "string", "enum": [ "running" ] }, { "description": "The instance has been requested to stop and a transition to \"Stopped\" is imminent.", "type": "string", "enum": [ "stopping" ] }, { "description": "The instance is currently stopped.", "type": "string", "enum": [ "stopped" ] }, { "description": "The instance is in the process of rebooting - it will remain in the \"rebooting\" state until the VM is starting once more.", "type": "string", "enum": [ "rebooting" ] }, { "description": "The instance is in the process of migrating - it will remain in the \"migrating\" state until the migration process is complete and the destination propolis is ready to continue execution.", "type": "string", "enum": [ "migrating" ] }, { "description": "The instance is attempting to recover from a failure.", "type": "string", "enum": [ "repairing" ] }, { "description": "The instance has encountered a failure.", "type": "string", "enum": [ "failed" ] }, { "description": "The instance has been deleted.", "type": "string", "enum": [ "destroyed" ] } ] } ``` </details>

oneOf.description: The instance is currently starting up.
The instance has been requested to stop and a transition to "Stopped" is imminent.
The instance is in the process of rebooting - it will remain in the "rebooting" state until the VM is starting once more.
The instance is in the process of migrating - it will remain in the "migrating" state until the migration process is complete and the destination propolis is ready to continue execution.
The instance is attempting to recover from a failure.
The instance has encountered a failure.

OxideInstance.description: Information about an Oxide instance that underpins a VW instance.

external_ip.description:
The address to reach this instance on, once it has one.

Absent until the instance exists and the control plane has attached an external address to it.

id.description:
The Oxide instance id, once the control plane has assigned one.

Absent in the window between asking for an instance and hearing back about it, which is long enough to be worth showing: an environment mid-creation reports `creating` with no id rather than looking like nothing has happened.

SshKeyPair.description:
The ssh keypair that opens an environment's instances.

Generated by the service when the environment is created and handed out only to the environment's owner.

private_key.description: The private key, in OpenSSH format, ready to pass to `ssh -i`.

public_key.description: The matching public key, as it appears in an `authorized_keys` file.
